From the front door to the back fence.

A full range of landscaping services to transform your garden into an attractive, functional outdoor space. Every photo below is the firm’s own work.

Patios and paving

A patio that stands the test of time and needs little maintenance. Brick and block paving, flagstones and slabs, from affordable sandstone to luxury finishes including slate, often combined for a functional, attractive finish.

Garden walls and steps

Walls that give a secure boundary, divide a garden into areas, or hold back a slope as a retaining wall to make level space you can use. Steps link the levels.

Decking

Timber and composite decks, from a stained hardwood terrace with steps to composite decking with glass balustrades and views out over the valley.

Turfing, planting and ponds

New lawns, borders and planting, ponds and water features. A bare yard or an overgrown plot turned into somewhere green.

Driveways and entrances

Driveways, gateways and front gardens: cobbles, setts, resin and paving, with the walling and planting to suit the house.

Some projects in more depth.

Nine jobs from the firm’s own projects page, from a small town yard finished in under a week to terraces cut into a steep slope.

  1. Bishopston

    High end landscaping

    Comprehensive relandscaping of front and back gardens, combining traditional and contemporary styles and a wide range of materials.

  2. Failand

    Contemporary garden design

    Smooth white sandstone, white rendered walls, composite decking and multiple levels, bringing the inside out and making the most of stunning views.

  3. Long Ashton

    Terracing and landscaping

    Working with significant slopes: large scale re-landscaping and some impressive central steps to link the two main terraces.

  4. Redland

    Driveway and front garden

    The existing driveway and front garden stripped out and started again, with an attractive cobbled driveway to complement the Victorian house.

  5. Stoke Bishop

    Large scale landscaping

    A comprehensive overhaul of a large overgrown space into a practical, visually stunning garden.

  6. Emersons Green

    Garden makeover

    Working from an existing design, with considerable building work and some more unusual materials, to create a Mediterranean style garden with different areas for summer and entertaining.

  7. Bishopston

    Garden design

    Every last bit of the existing garden stripped out, then a blank canvas: fencing, edging, paving, turfing, steps, drainage and more.

  8. Near Abbots Leigh

    Terracing, retaining walls and a concrete pad

    A steep, overgrown wasteland levelled into three terraces with a digger, then block and stone retaining walls and a concrete pad on the lower tier.

  9. St Andrews

    Small town garden

    A bare, lifeless yard turned into a green area with paving for table and chairs, completed in under a week.
